title: Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this implantable device application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by permanent pacemaker outer hermetic enclosure and service environment demands.
process: CNC swiss turning for implantable device geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for permanent pacemaker outer application
inspection: Mech test ASTM per std (permanent pacemaker verified)
commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for permanent pacemaker outer performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure suitable for Permanent pacemaker outer hermetic enclosure?
faq.a: Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address implantable device operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for permanent pacemaker outer requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. permanent pacemaker outer components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for permanent pacemaker outer application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet permanent pacemaker outer specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Pacemaker case / IPG housing implantable device components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
